# MySentry - Full Page Inventory for LLMs

> MySentry is a Safety and Health monitoring app with Emergency Response. It combines panic alarm, fall detection, crash detection, real-time health monitoring (HRV, SpO2, heart rate), emergency contacts, live video response, and 24/7 professional monitoring into one app for individuals, families, seniors, and employers.

## Product Overview

MySentry turns smartphones and smartwatches into 24/7 safety and health monitoring devices. When an emergency is detected (fall, crash, health anomaly) or triggered manually (panic button, voice command), the system alerts 24/7 professional monitoring agents who can view live video, verify the situation, and dispatch emergency services. Emergency contacts receive instant notifications with GPS location.

## Core Features

### Panic Button App
URL: https://mysentry.ai/features/panic-button-app
One tap or voice command triggers an alert to 24/7 monitoring agents and emergency contacts. Includes discreet activation modes for situations where visible phone use is unsafe.

### Fall Detection App
URL: https://mysentry.ai/features/fall-detection-app
Uses phone and smartwatch accelerometer and gyroscope sensors to detect falls. If the user does not respond within a countdown period, an alert is automatically sent to 24/7 monitoring with live video and GPS location.

### Crash Detection
URL: https://mysentry.ai/features/crash-detection
Detects vehicle crashes using phone GPS speed data combined with accelerometer impact patterns. Automatically alerts emergency services and contacts when a crash is confirmed.

### 24/7 Professional Monitoring
URL: https://mysentry.ai/features/24-7-professional-monitoring
Certified monitoring agents available around the clock. They receive alerts with live video feed, GPS location, and health data. They verify the emergency and dispatch appropriate help.

### Emergency Contacts
URL: https://mysentry.ai/features/emergency-contacts
Designated contacts receive SMS, push notification, and email alerts with real-time GPS location during any emergency event.

### Live Video Response
URL: https://mysentry.ai/features/live-video-response
During an emergency, the phone camera streams live video to monitoring agents so they can assess the scene, communicate with the user, and provide accurate information to first responders.

### Health Monitoring
URL: https://mysentry.ai/features/health-monitoring
Tracks heart rate, heart rate variability (HRV), blood oxygen (SpO2), and skin temperature via Apple Watch or Samsung Watch. Alerts users and contacts when readings fall outside safe ranges.

### MeetSafe Check-Ins
URL: https://mysentry.ai/features/meetsafe-check-ins
Timed safety check-ins for meetings, dates, or appointments. If the user does not check in by the timer deadline, an alert is sent to monitoring and emergency contacts.

## Audience Segments

### Women's Safety
URL: https://mysentry.ai/females
Discreet panic activation, location sharing, and 24/7 monitoring for women walking alone, dating, running, or traveling solo.

### Senior Safety
URL: https://mysentry.ai/seniors
Fall detection, health monitoring, and emergency response designed for independent seniors and their caregivers.

### Family Safety
URL: https://mysentry.ai/families
Connected safety for the whole family: teen driver crash detection, child location sharing, senior parent monitoring, and family emergency alerts.

### Employer/Workforce Safety
URL: https://mysentry.ai/employers
Lone worker protection, incident detection, compliance support, and 24/7 monitoring for field employees across industries.
